import csv
from collections import defaultdict

cool='93d84ff6-9ef2-55af-89d2-e5a6dcfc33b0'
heat='0cede4f2-cbcf-5fe8-9f4b-e6428317da44'
temp='a6b53f83-d378-5a08-b723-6834fcbf5b60'

data=defaultdict(dict)
with open(VALUES_CSV) as f:
    r=csv.reader(f)
    hdr=next(r)
    for tid, ts, val in r:
        if tid in (cool,heat,temp):
            data[tid][ts]=val

date='2018-01-14'
def ondate(ts): return ts.startswith(date)
ctimes=[t for t in data[cool] if ondate(t)]
htimes=[t for t in data[heat] if ondate(t)]
tvals=[t for t in data[temp] if ondate(t)]
print("cool n",len(ctimes),"heat n",len(htimes),"temp n",len(tvals))
print("sorted sample cool",sorted(ctimes)[:3])
# union of times present in temp
allt=sorted(set(tvals))
bad=[]
present_all=True
for t in allt:
    if t not in data[cool] or t not in data[heat]:
        present_all=False
    else:
        tv=float(data[temp][t]); cv=float(data[cool][t]); hv=float(data[heat][t])
        if not (hv <= tv <= cv):
            bad.append((t,tv,hv,cv))
print("present_all",present_all)
print("num temp rows",len(allt))
print("bad count",len(bad))
for b in bad[:10]:
    print(b)
